# Separate MIME plain-data zeroing from C++ member construction

The fixed mime_new zeroes raw object storage, then calls clazz->cpp_construct before the MIME initialize method. Failure later calls finalize, cpp_destruct and PR_Free. The 2025 leak repair predates this fuller lifecycle. Recommend preserving both native MIME finalization and C++ member destruction when changing this allocator. No object-allocation or destructor failure was executed. This is source and test-code inspection. Complete Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.

Scope: mailnews/mime/src.
